connector.name: SWT3 AI Witness
connector.registryDescription: Cryptographic AI governance + audit. 22 tools, 31 frameworks. EU AI Act, NIST, OWASP, CMMC, SR 11-7
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package swt3-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.tenova, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.description: Path to swt3.yaml config file for policy-as-code

recipes.cli: claude mcp add swt3-witness --env SWT3_API_KEY=<your-swt3-api-key> --env SWT3_TENANT_ID=<swt3-tenant-id> --env SWT3_CONFIG_FILE=<swt3-config-file> --env SWT3_CLEARING_LEVEL=<swt3-clearing-level> --env SWT3_AGENT_ID=<swt3-agent-id> --env SWT3_SIGNING_KEY=<your-swt3-signing-key> -- npx -y @tenova/swt3-mcp@0.6.1

recipes.code:
[mcp_servers.swt3-witness]
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "@tenova/swt3-mcp@0.6.1"]

[mcp_servers.swt3-witness.env]
SWT3_API_KEY = "<your-swt3-api-key>"
SWT3_TENANT_ID = "<swt3-tenant-id>"
SWT3_CONFIG_FILE = "<swt3-config-file>"
SWT3_CLEARING_LEVEL = "<swt3-clearing-level>"
SWT3_AGENT_ID = "<swt3-agent-id>"
SWT3_SIGNING_KEY = "<your-swt3-signing-key>"
